name: v3.10.4-rc1
body:
Version 3.10.4 (unreleased)

This release routes every file path, archive, download, URL fetch and external program through one sandbox that keeps reads and writes inside the trusted data directories, refuses path traversal, symlink escapes and decompression bombs, blocks requests to internal network addresses, and runs Java and other third-party tools only from trusted absolute locations with validated options and input. Pickled models now load through a restricted unpickler, XML and JSON parsing are hardened, and regular expressions, recursion and slow algorithms in the tokenizers, parsers, stemmers and corpus readers are bounded against denial-of-service input. Text that NLTK writes to the terminal, to CSV files, to the WordNet browser and to third-party tool input is sanitized against injection.

* Downloaded package archives stay private to the installing account (0600). An install another account must read is extracted: a download made as root or outside the installing account's home extracts on its own, and `nltk.download(..., extract=True)` / `python -m nltk.downloader --extract` (or `--no-extract`) decide explicitly. This also unpacks the packages the index leaves zipped (wordnet, omw-1.4 ...); the extracted files are readable by every account and are found before the archive, and `nltk.download()` called by that account reports the package installed. `find()` now names an archive it cannot read and says how to extract it instead of reporting it "not found" (#3928)
* `nltk.data.find()` refuses a data root, or a directory on the way to a resource, that another account can write to: a file planted there would be loaded as trusted data. It warns, names the directory and the remedy, and keeps searching later roots. A corpus root is judged with everything under it, and an archive is judged again on the descriptor at every read
* The downloader installs only into directories no other account can write to, creates them without a group or world write bit whatever the umask, treats an archive another account owns or can write to as stale and downloads it afresh, and extracts only from an archive no other account could have changed since its checksum was verified
* Create perceptron model files exclusively under the pinned directory (issue 3980) (PR #3981)
* Make Tree.__repr__ iterative so a deep accepted tree does not overflow the stack (PR #3977)
* Guard java() cmd[0] against JEP 330 source-file execution, verified on a real JDK (PR #3975)
* Bound YAML deserialization against depth and resource DoS, verified on the real loaders (PR #3974)
* Fix DependencyGraph cycle detection, dead on every parsed graph (PR #3978)
* Open gzip file names through pathsec, and refuse a linked PanLex Lite database (PR #3961)
* Route the downloader, XML corpus view, internals and Toolbox through nltk.xmlsec and nltk.data (PR #3972)
* Harden the Toolbox reader and writers after the #3958 re-audit (PR #3962)
* Refuse relation walks deeper than MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH instead of truncating them (PR #3960)
* Fix the develop CI breakage from the fg9w advisory merge (Senna -path separator, test fixtures under /tmp) (PR #3971)
* Route every module's file removal, rename, privacy test and sqlite open through pathsec (PR #3969)
* Close the chat80 store swap window and read stores by a key manifest (PR #3964)
* CI: take the Windows Graphviz from the cached third-party tools, not Chocolatey (PR #3968)
* Keep full collections out of timed scaling samples (89p3 teeth and relextract reds) (PR #3963)
* Let chat80.val_load read back what val_dump wrote (PR #3959)
* Restore add_blank_lines and to_settings_string after the GHSA-f2h2 depth bound (PR #3958)
* Fix #3394: Ensure punkt_tab is downloaded when punkt is requested (PR #3505)
* Guard the two-class any-character runs and count apostrophe-named groups (follow-up to #3895) (PR #3953)
* Bound algorithmic-DoS and uncontrolled-recursion vectors (CWE-400/407/674/1333) (PR #3895)
* [Do not merge yet] Keep downloaded archives private and serve other accounts through extraction (fixes #3928) (PR #3929)
* Support symlinked executables in pathsec (PR #3951)
* Trusted spawn: O_NOFOLLOW and inode check on the final file, link owner and control-character checks, refusal reasons, argv[0] as invoked; real Graphviz in CI (#3887 follow-up) (PR #3950)
* Pair the scaling samples by rep and size the under-margined probes over the floor (PR #3949)
* Add the 3.10.4 commit authors and security reporters to AUTHORS.md (PR #3948)
* Make the word, blankline and TextTiling tokenizers, the valuation parser, relextract and toktok linear on retried leading regex runs (PR #3947)
* Added RTL language syntactic tree visualization support (PR #3472)
* [Do not merge yet] Guard tool wrappers, Prover9 input and the downloader against injection and unbounded-response DoS (PR #3850)
* Parse CCG lexicon categories in linear time and refuse oversized ones, verified under attack and on the documented grammars (GHSA-89p3-fcch-88ph, split from #3753) (PR #3944)
* Guard the maxent parameter files against outside-root paths and unrepresentable names, verified on a real trained model (PR #3945)
* Guard the twitter CSV exports against formula and control-sequence injection, verified on the real corpus (PR #3946)
* Bring the self-contained tests of #3753 to develop (PR #3940)
* Guard the Stanford tagger and segmenter input against line injection, verified on the real tools (PR #3941)
* Surface the CoreNLP server's reason for a non-2xx answer and warm the live test server (PR #3942)
* ci(deps): bump dorny/paths-filter from 3 to 4 in the github-actions group (PR #3943)
* Measure probe scaling in process CPU time so a loaded runner cannot flip a verdict (PR #3939)
* Make the CoNLL SRL, TIMIT and XML view readers linear, and parse corpus XML through xmlsec (GHSA-v8f3) (PR #3933)
* Fix UTF-8 text preprocessing in NKJP corpus reader (PR #3879)
* Walk semi-relations once in relextract, and keep a pattern's flags in redos.reharden (PR #3935)
* Find readline's line boundary with str.splitlines, not a timed regex (PR #3938)
* Never leave the pop of an escaped bidi override live in sanitize_terminal (PR #3937)
* Align quote tokens in linear time in the Treebank and NLTK word tokenizers (PR #3934)
* Escape AlignedSent DOT labels, refuse NUL, and keep the alignment checks under -O (PR #3930)
* Read a long line in linear time in SeekableUnicodeStreamReader.readline (GHSA-j8g8) (PR #3932)
* Sanitise the CSV cells and report lines the sentiment helpers write (PR #3931)
* Consolidate the nltk/parse guards from #3753 and #3850 and judge their inputs on real characters (PR #3927)
* Consolidate the internals, downloader, pathsec and decorators guards from #3753 and #3850 (PR #3926)
* Extend the tool model-file guards to crf, stanford tagger and segmenter (PR #3871)
* Validate chat80.sql_query dbname for path containment (CWE-59/73) (PR #3888)
* Pin the GHSA-cc5r-64rf-75hg proof of concept end to end and run its sink as probe phase 6 (follow-up to #3887) (PR #3925)
* Log the perceptron training progress on the module logger (fixes the develop 3.10/3.11 cells) (PR #3924)
* Route every library print through the nltk.termsec.safe_print chokepoint (PR #3915)
* Fix the XMLCorpusView ReDoS-test Windows CI flake (in-process op timing + Windows autoload) (PR #3912)
* Fix develop CI on Python 3.10/3.11: let deepcopy reach MAX_TREE_DEPTH (PR #3917)
* Bound SyllableTokenizer fallback-vowel accumulation (CWE-400 / CWE-407) (PR #3911)
* [WIP] Fix quadratic DoS in Tree.chomsky_normal_form right-factor binarization (GHSA-r53h-rw34-8h97) (PR #3909)
* Add nltk.termsec terminal-output sanitizer with attack-matrix tests (PR #3914)
* Make help._format_tagset fail closed on an oversized tag pattern (fix develop CI) (PR #3910)
* Handle the redos MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH refusal for a tgrep /regex/ node literal (PR #3908)
* Handle the redos MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH refusal in TokenSearcher.findall (PR #3907)
* Handle the redos MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH refusal in help._format_tagset (PR #3906)
* Add GHSA-j456 live probe; expand the GHSA-8mgp probe attack set (PR #3905)
* Fix resolution paths that cancel distinct literals (PR #3878)
* Remove shadowed FeatStruct._walk stub and preserve its docstring (PR #3893)
* Potential fix for code scanning alert no. 28: Clear-text logging of sensitive information (PR #3902)
* Count all increasing pairs in RIBES kendall_tau (PR #3900)
* Extend no-unsandboxed-open guard to gzip/bz2/lzma/zipfile/tempfile (+ coverage test) (PR #3904)
* Make DoS/ReDoS timing regression tests load-invariant (fix CI flakiness) (PR #3899)
* Harden CoreNLPServer start attempts (PR #3894)
* Harden and complete the CoreNLP server-option allowlist (CWE-88/22/502) (PR #3868)
* Bound recursion depth in parsers and traversal helpers (PR #3885)
* Give every pathsec refusal the standard Security Violation marker (spawn_trusted + ZIP audit) (PR #3877)
* Don't miscount a python-crfsuite Windows failure as a pathsec over-block (tag sweep) (PR #3876)
* Harden and standardize NLTK's external-tool wrappers on a pathsec trusted-spawn API (CWE-426/427/732/93/88) (PR #3858)
* Deflake anti-DoS timing tests and harden senseval _fixXML leading-run ReDoS (PR #3869)
* Tidy transitionparser security comments to one point per <=3 lines (PR #3866)
* Bound the WekaClassifier model path to the pathsec data roots (PR #3863)
* Open operator-chosen app/twitter paths with an annotated builtin open, not pathsec.open (PR #3865)
* Exclude pytest's ephemeral basetemp from the pickle-asset scanner (PR #3864)
* Add the all-regex-through-redos pre-commit guard and two regression tests (PR #3862)
* Extend the no-unsandboxed-open guard to app/draw/twitter and route every open through pathsec.open (PR #3861)
* Add test-only regression coverage for already-fixed CWEs (PR #3860)
* Escape corpus-derived text in the WordNet browser app (CWE-79 XSS) (PR #3856)
* Add and expand security / ReDoS attack test coverage (PR #3855)
* Re-check the normalized form of a no-protocol resource path against traversal (CWE-22) (PR #3853)
* Refuse NUL bytes in pathsec.validate_path; add a pathsec attack-candidate harness (PR #3852)
* Fix newline in ellipsis tokens in TweetTokenizer (PR #3819)
* Bound JSON deserialization against deep-nesting crash and resource DoS (PR #3828)
* Stage REPP scratch input in an nltk.data root instead of the shared system temp (PR #3851)
* Route security-test fixtures through the pathsec I/O helpers (PR #3849)
* Guard model-artifact loaders against un-sandboxed open() (PR #3848)
* Strengthen the advisory security-probe harness (guards already on develop) (PR #3820)
* Add security regression tests + harden SSRF filter (transition tunnels, IP literals) (PR #3847)
* Harden RegexpStemmer against pre-compiled ReDoS patterns (CWE-1333) (PR #3846)
* Bound compile-time DoS (ValueError) in the concordance and nemo GUI regex handlers (CWE-1333/CWE-400) (PR #3845)
* Route nltk.ccg regexes through nltk.redos (CWE-1333/CWE-400) (PR #3830)

* Route top-level nltk regexes through nltk.redos (CWE-1333/CWE-400) (PR #3844)
* Bound regex compilation against a compile-time DoS (PR #3825)
* Bound algorithmic-complexity (time) DoS in stemmers, metrics, parsers (CWE-407 / CWE-770) (PR #3827)
* Load nltk.tbl.demo models through an allowlisting unpickler (PR #3823)
* Add redos.source_of/reharden and picklesec.harden_object_graph (PR #3824)
* Add remaining GHSA-8mgp security regression tests (pathsec/java/redos/archive/corpus) (PR #3821)
* Fix develop CI: register data roots for benign save/IO tests broken by pathsec hardening (PR #3822)
* Add tests covering already-merged pathsec/security guards (PR #3818)
* Harden nltk.tbl.demo model load/save through picklesec and pathsec (PR #3817)

* Harden tagger model loads and tool paths (perceptron/crf/hunpos/stanford) (PR #3813)

* Harden the VERSION read in nltk package init with pathsec.open_package_resource (PR #3803)
* Canonicalize obfuscated numeric IPv4 in the SSRF guard (CWE-918) (PR #3810)

* Pin maxent scratch files to a data root and validate scratch IO (PR #3807)

* Refuse CWD-relative matches for bare names in find_file/find_dir (CWE-427) (PR #3798)
